focus: risk-first mutable naming, IPNS lessons, BEP44 mutable slots, UCAN-like capabilities and revocation

sources.name: IPNS Record and Protocol
sources.use: Treat as useful field vocabulary but not a template: value, validity, sequence, TTL, public key, signature.

sources.name: IPNS over DHT and PubSub discussion
sources.use: Motivates avoiding single-route DHT mutable lookup assumptions and testing delivery-path pain.

sources.name: IPNS high availability discussion
sources.use: Highlights DHT record expiration and independent TTL/validity concerns.

sources.name: BEP44 mutable items
sources.use: Retains Ed25519, salt, seq, CAS, signature semantics as the compact mutable-slot teacher.

sources.name: UCAN specification
sources.use: Delegation vocabulary: scoped capability chains, validity intervals, peer-verifiable authority.

sources.name: UCAN revocation
sources.use: Revocation is a last-resort, eventually-known invalidation, not undo magic.

design_takeaway: Do not build a plain latest-pointer clone. Implement history-aware heads, local monotonic memory, witness evidence, and scoped expiring capabilities before live transport.
